scope: card semantic direct-matrix evidence; trigger Power cards refreshed
fixed_semantics: PIERCING_WAIL temporary all-enemy Strength loss and intent refresh
UPPERCUT shared power preview maps Weak and Vulnerable
DARK_EMBRACE exhaust trigger draw
FEEL_NO_PAIN exhaust trigger block
THRASH repeated damage with random Attack exhaust and selection RNG
FIGHT_ME repeated attack, self Strength and enemy Strength synchronization
SETUP_STRIKE temporary self Strength and SetupStrike power synchronization
EXPOSE clear enemy Block/Artifact and apply Vulnerable
OUTBREAK Poison application plus immediate trigger damage
DODGE_AND_ROLL next-turn block power
BLUR retain block into next turn
AGGRESSION persistent TurnStart power marker
COLOSSUS Vulnerable-enemy damage reduction Power with DamageDecrease dynamic var
CLOAK_AND_DAGGER generated Shiv in Hand (runtime stats.cards)
BLADE_DANCE/UP_MY_SLEEVE generated Shiv cards from runtime stats.cards
calculateddamage fallback for cards whose runtime preview omits base damage
repeat count from stats.repeat or description twice
DRUM_OF_BATTLE energy is Exhaust trigger, not immediate gain
PACTS_END damage gated by exhaust_pile_count >= cards threshold
calculatedhits=0 suppresses dynamic multi-hit damage
calculatedblock fallback for runtime resolved block previews
ESCAPE_PLAN conditional block withheld when drawn-skill outcome is not observed
PYRE maps to PYRE_POWER / TURN_START_ENERGY (no immediate energy)
ANTICIPATE temporary Dexterity plus ANTICIPATE_POWER marker
next-card-free, scheduled draw, and Strangle power markers
JUGGLING/UNMOVABLE/SPEEDSTER/JUGGERNAUT live Power markers and trigger phases
